state_of_the_art.statement: No documented maximum for B_3 sets in [1,4096]; the greedy B_3 sequence (OEIS A096772) already has 16 terms up to 4048. Asymptotically the maximum is between (1+o(1))N^(1/3) (Bose and Chowla) and ((7/2)^(1/3)+o(1))N^(1/3) (Green), Erdős Problem #241.
